en: I'm sorry $g mon : sis;, but I won't be sellin' my raptors to someone who hasn't proven themselves to be exalted to the Darkspear tribe.  When ya make a stand and show yourself to be no less than exalted to us, then I'll make my raptors available to ya.
Elder Bellowrage watches over the Dark Portal from a ridge in the Blasted Lands.
Don't let the heat bother you.  In the Badlands, heat is the least of your worries.
I had it all!  I had it all and then I lost it.  Lost... all gone... like... my mind.  My mind is like... cheese.  I like cheese.
We will not be swayed from our mission!

A closer inspection of the pylon leads you to find a small table containing yellow, red, and green crystals arranged in what seems like a specific formation.$B$BA large yellow circle of crystals is flanked on either side by a smaller circle of red crystals and another of green crystals.$B$BYou carefully take note of the colors of the crystals, knowing that J.D. would be very interested in hearing about what you have found.
I was standing right next to you, imbecile. I know what you seek.
Could ye spare some coin?
You seek a higher knowledge. Tepa is blessed with such knowledge. She should be standing somewhere nearby...
Yeah, that would be Austil de Mon.  He's always hanging out in the tavern at the southeast end of town.  It's called the Gallows' End Tavern, you can't miss it.
You got questions, but they be too big for me to answer, $n. You be needin' to have words with the orc Yelmak in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He'll help you out.
%s seems to no longer be able to cast spells. The Felcurse is working!

I am Ulysses Rackmore, captain of the Gallant.  And this is the log of the last few days of my doomed ship.$B$BWe were sailing to Feathermoon Stronghold with a shipment of supplies when naga stormed the sides of the Gallant.  We drove them back but we knew they'd return.  Fearing the loss of my most precious belongings, I steered the Gallant to an island off the coast of Desolace, one with old, night elf ruins.  And there I left my treasure chest.
See what I mean?  Get inside right now.
This doesn't look good!
%s begins to summon in a Blackhand Veteran!
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.$B$BWe must do what we can against the Dark Irons!
The coils of death will crush you!
At last - one among you is worthy of my knowledge. Worry not - I have probed your thoughts, no harm will come to you.

Aye, I could tell just by looking at you, $n. You remind me very much of myself as a young warrior of the Horde.$B$BYou will undoubtedly go far in life and even further in death.$B$B<Goretooth salutes.>

A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.
Friends of yours?
Rexxar, I have lost the Drakefire Amulet. Could another be created?
And stay down!
We will never allow it... We have banished him from our world before and we will banish him again.
Sorry, but I only train rogues.
At last, my soul is free!
The Horde has taken the mine!

All has been gathered and is being sent to Silithus, $c. It should get there within $2113w days. I can only hope that after the gong is rung, and the gates opened, that our efforts here will make an impact and save many lives.
I'm ready when you are, $n. Lead the way!
Defiler... you will be punished for this incursion. <A symbol of flame radiates from the relic before it crumbles to the earth.>
Blast those stupid centaurs! Sigh - well, it seems you kept your bargain. Up the road you shall find Smeed Scrabblescrew, he has your money.
So what do you want to do today?
Putting in twelve centers of focus might allow the magical energies to form more solidly, adding the necessary stability.
Hurry brothers! You must go now! I do not know how much longer the rift will remain open!
I appreciate the company, but let's face it: you have more experience with potions than I do. Talk to Doctor Marsh instead if you want training. He's a Forsaken in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.

I've heard that the preparations are being shipped over to Silithus and should all arrive in under $2113w days. I don't want to see one of those bugs burrowing through into my mine, so I hope that someone is taking the time to assemble that Scepter of the Shifting Sands so the gong can be rung, the gates opened and the war finally begun.
Warriors can usually be found either at the Pig and Whistle Tavern or the Barracks in Old Town. Tell ya though, the tavern is probably a better place look.
Are we there yet?
The Eye led me here, Eris.

Love tokens are small messages of affection you can give to amorous town and city folk.  Such people will reward you with a gift of adoration.$B$BOr, if you are already adored by another, then at the least they'll give you a gift of friendship.
Stand back, and ... hold your breath.  I haven't done this in a while.
For so long I have drifted in my cursed form. You have freed me... Your hard work shall be repaid.
